title: Beyond Extractives: Unlocking Mauritania’s Potential for a Sustained, Inclusive and Resilient Growth (Country Growth and Jobs Report 2025)
temporal_coverage: Observed climate and drought impacts since 1950 and 2020-2022; modeled climate impacts to 2050
methodology: Country report combines climate-risk discussion and modeled growth impacts.
limitations: Macroeconomic estimates depend on climate/adaptation scenarios; drought impact is an upper-bound share.

title: Country Climate and Development Report: G5 Sahel
temporal_coverage: Country-specific growth, climate, and poverty scenarios to 2050
methodology: The G5 CCDR models each country separately and links macro projections to household-survey microsimulation.
limitations: Regional framing includes four other countries; distributional modeling does not account for household location or characteristics.

title: Climate, Peace and Security in Mauritania: Executive Summary
organization: United Nations Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs (DPPA), United Nations Office for West Africa and the Sahel (UNOWAS), and Climate Security Mechanism
temporal_coverage: Study based on literature and country fieldwork in 2023; executive summary published 26 September 2024.
methodology: UN review and 2023 field visit with community, UN and government interviews.
limitations: Executive summary only; pathways remain plausible, geographically broad and unquantified.

title: Analyse du paysage climatique pour les enfants en Mauritanie (Climate Landscape Analysis for Children)
temporal_coverage: Climate and child-vulnerability analysis; report carries UNICEF Mauritania copyright 2024 and includes historical 2022 flood impacts.
methodology: UNICEF synthesis of documents, policies, risk maps and stakeholder/youth input.
limitations: Child climate-risk scores are not FCV measures; conditions may have changed.

title: Mauritania: Refugee Emergency Response (as of 30 June 2024)
organization: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR)
temporal_coverage: Refugee-response snapshot as of 30 June 2024; published 2 August 2024.
methodology: Two-page UNHCR operational response update using registration, arrival-monitoring and needs information.
limitations: Historical operational snapshot; service plans and outputs are not impact evaluations.

title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief: Mauritania
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), Global Information and Early Warning System
temporal_coverage: GIEWS reference date 9 September 2025; includes 2025 lean-season food-security estimates and rainy-season conditions through August.
methodology: FAO GIEWS synthesis of crop, rainfall, food-security and Cadre Harmonisé analysis.
limitations: Seasonal 2025 snapshot, not an update on current 2026 conditions.
